page0.text:
"Hngh!"
I retreat immediately.
This isn't a good time to fight.
I need to regroup and make Shinji stop the Bounded Field...
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page0:1

page1.text:
"Gah...!?"
I'm not sure what happened, but I retreat desperately.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page1:1

page2.text:
"Ha...ah...aaah!"
Fear makes everything in front of me appear completely white.
I don't even know what I'm so terrified of.
Without thinking, I throw an arm out to cover my neck.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page2:1

page3.text:
"Zhgh...!"
Something sharp buries itself in my arm.
The dull sound of scraping bone tells me the next attack will end me.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page3:1

page4.text:
"Ha...kn...gh!"
I run.
I can't afford to look back.
I just cover my vital spots with my hands as best I can in my frantic retreat.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page4:1

page5.text:
"Heee...geeehhhh!"
Creak...cr-cr-cr-cr-c-rrrkkk...
The sharp edge slowly saws through my body with a horrible, jarring sound.
A spray of my own blood blots out my vision.
Meanwhile...
Rider is rushing toward me so quickly that I can't even see her.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page5:1

page6.text:
"Gkkkgh!"
With each cut, I hear sounds I can't even recognize coming from my own mouth.
But I continue my desperate retreat, somehow surviving the dozens of fatal blows striking at me.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page6:1

page7.text:
"Ha...hah...haaa...hah!"
I don't know what I'm doing.
Rider's dagger is buried in my arm.
My clothes are tattered and torn, and my flesh is brutally shredded.
But I'm still able to shield myself with my own body, blocking the attacks aimed at my neck and head.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page7:1

page8.text:
This isn't a conscious thing at all anymore.
Pure instinct drives my reactions as I desperately try to survive Rider's attacks.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page8:1

page9.text:
"Ah...a...ha...!"
My breathing is labored.
I'm only running away, rushed along by the imminent death looming over me.
Eventually, whatever strength I have left will fade, and she'll catch up to me. Then I'm dead.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page9:1

page10.text:
"Gh...ah...h!!!"
That's what Saber had been trying to tell me.
Don't fight against a Servant. Fight wouldn't even be the right word for it.
She told me again and again, so...why the hell am I in this position now? All I want to do is catch Shinji as fast as possible and make him shut off this goddamn Bounded Field... So what the hell am I doing!?
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page10:1

page11.text:
"What are you doing, Rider?
That's enough. Just end this already. He can't do anything anyway."
Shinji is elated, his voice triumphant.
Rider nods, and swings her dagger up in a wide arc.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page11:1

page12.text:
She's striking at my head.
I can't dodge.
All I can really do is to try to prevent her from hitting anything vital.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page12:1

page13.text:
"...Ngh!"
The dagger stabs into my shoulder...right below the collarbone.
I hear a high-pitched, metallic sound, then the click of a tongue.
"Eh...?"
What? The end of Rider's dagger is starting to disintegrate...
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page13:1

page14.text:
"This is a surprise. I cannot kill you with my blade."
Rider stops.
In that instant, I frantically try to come up with a way to leverage this sudden opportunity.
"Then gravity shall kill you."
Something strikes me with all the force of a sledgehammer, and I go flying out the window.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page14:1

page15.text:
"Ga...h...!"
It had only been a kick to the stomach.
But I go flying, shattering the window.
We're on the third floor.
Left alone, I'll die of blood loss anyway, so a fall from this height will be enough to finish me off.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page15:1

page16.text:
I mean, an ordinary human would be dead on the spot from a blow strong enough to send them flying like this anyway.
"A...ah...hhh"
I reach out.
Maybe I'm not falling yet...or maybe I'm just hallucinating right before I die?
But my body is still suspended in midair.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page16:1

page17.text:
"...Uh? H...ow?"
I reach out, desperately grasping for something, anything.
The sky is crimson.
The school is pulsating, like a creature's stomach.
And am I...
Am I just going to die...let something like this happen?
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page17:1

page18.text:
Let...
Let this...
Let this happen?
Am I going to let myself die without saving so much as a single person!?
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page18:1

page19.text:
"I...can't...!"
I grit my teeth furiously.
I can't win. This is not even a battle. I knew that going in, but I still screwed it up.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page19:1

page20.text:
There's no more pain.
All I feel is my sheer rage making my insides unravel.
I thought I could do it alone.
This is what I get for saying I won't let Saber fight.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page20:1

page21.text:
"...Ng!"
I was an idiot.
I can't save anyone on my own.
If I really wanted to end this war, there was one thing I should have done right from the start.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page21:1

page22.text:
He asked me...
...whether I was really not going to fight, not kill, and not let anyone kill...
If I realize my mistake, I should first decide what to fix, then decide who to punish.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page22:1

page23.text:
And then...
I see it. There on my arm, still reaching up as if to touch the heavens. My Command Spells...waiting for an order...
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-08:page23:1
